shortDescription: Manages the software upgrade process on devices.

options.name: devices
options.description: A list of device identifiers to apply the software operation to.

options.name: downgrade_check
options.description: Whether to perform a downgrade check before installing the software.

options.name: filters
options.description: A dictionary of filters to apply.

options.name: force
options.description: Whether to force the removal of the software image.

options.name: image_path
options.description: The path to the image to install.

options.name: image_version
options.description: The version of the image to install/activate.

options.name: manager_credentials
options.description: Credentials to authenticate with the vManage instance.

options.name: reboot
options.description: Whether to reboot the device after installation.

options.name: remote_image_filename
options.description: The filename of the image on the remote server.

options.name: remote_server_name
options.description: The name of the remote server where the image is located.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the software image on the device(s).

options.name: sync
options.description: Whether to synchronize the device after installation.

options.name: wait_for_completed
options.description: Whether to wait for the installation to complete before exiting.

options.name: wait_timeout_seconds
options.description: The maximum time to wait for the software operation to complete.
